name: Giga Mansion Tycoon 🏝️
desc:
Welcome to Blockywood🌴 - Build your dream houses! Maybe a modern Giga Mansion, Beach house, Giga Villa and GIGA YACHT?! Buy luxury sports cars, helicopters AND MORE!

🏆 THE MOST BUTTONS TYCOON ON ROBLOX!
🏆 THE BIGGEST HOUSES/MANSIONS ON ROBLOX!

🔔 Press the NOTIFY button so you don't miss when new mansions drop!
❤️ Lagging? Try a FREE VIP SERVER!
🎮 Available on ALL platforms: PC, Mac, XBOX, Playstation, Mobile and Tablet!

There's no end to the adventures waiting for you:
🚗 Zoom around the city in the sleekest super luxury cars
🚢 Sail the seas with dream mega and giga yachts, speed boats and jetskis!
🚁 Take to the skies with luxury helicopters
🎭 Lots of interactable roleplay furniture

👍 Like the game for epic GIGA updates!👍
